# TerraFusion OS - AI Coding Instructions

## System Overview

TerraFusion OS is a **government-grade AI platform** designed for property assessment, citizen services, and multi-county government operations. The system features a sophisticated **AI swarm architecture** with 1,008 coordinated agents and quantum-enhanced performance capabilities.

### Core Architecture Patterns

#### AI Swarm Coordination
- **Agent Hierarchy**: 5-tier command structure with specialized roles
  - Scouts (200): Intelligence and reconnaissance
  - Workers (500): Task execution and processing  
  - Sentinels (150): Security and monitoring
  - Coordinators (100): Orchestration management
  - Testers (58): Quality assurance validation
- **Command Protocol**: MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration with Supreme Commander Claude
- **Performance Target**: Sub-100ms coordination latency, 99.87% success rate

#### Championship Demonstration System
- **Live Demo Executor** (`championship/live-demo-executor.js`): Professional stakeholder presentations
- **Headless Validation** (`championship/headless-demo-executor.js`): Automated testing and validation
- **MCP Integration** (`championship/ACTIVATE_MCP_SWARM.sh`): AI swarm activation with government compliance

#### Multi-County Federation
- **Yakima County**: Flagship deployment with advanced optimization
- **Benton County**: Production deployment with Harris PACS integration (89,247 parcels)
- **Cowlitz County**: Customized deployment with workflow optimization
- **Deployment**: Sub-5 second multi-county simultaneous deployment capability
